PARTNER_REPORT.TITLE: Partner inboxes
PARTNER_REPORT.AD_REPORT_DESCRIPTION: Ad acquisition across the account's WhatsApp inboxes, including unpaired inboxes. Missing referral evidence does not prove organic origin.
PARTNER_REPORT.AD_LEADS: Ad entries and estimated free windows
PARTNER_REPORT.AD_LEAD_HELP: Requires source_type ad and a nonempty source_id. Estimated window starts only after a delivered Meta reply within 24 h. All categories are exempt within it without consuming the service allowance. Dates and elapsed days are estimates, not billing confirmation. No proven eligible reply means no assumed exemption. Filters refine the selected period; 10 entries per page.
PARTNER_REPORT.AD_EMPTY: No ad entries match these filters.
PARTNER_REPORT.DESCRIPTION: Unique messages, provider receipts and estimated unified-inbox costs.
PARTNER_REPORT.TIMEZONE_HELP: Defaults to the account timezone, or the system default when unset. Select another timezone for this simulation without changing the account. Dates and the monthly cycle follow the selected timezone.
PARTNER_REPORT.RATE_HELP: Brazil BRL reference: service, utility and authentication 0.0350; marketing 0.3217. Editable rates; blank means unknown and zero means no charge. Saved values are preserved. No currency conversion or changes to Meta prices/sends.
PARTNER_REPORT.DAILY_CHART: Daily sends and attempts by provider
PARTNER_REPORT.COMPARISON_HELP: Recalculates confirmed deliveries, allowance, categories and windows, replacing ViperConnect with Meta. Excludes ViperConnect costs, taxes, volume discounts and provider markups. Not net savings or an invoice. Missing provider/delivery evidence does not generate invented costs; ViperConnect delivery does not prove Meta sending authorization.
PARTNER_REPORT.COMPARISON_GAPS: Hypothetical scenario gaps: {categories} deliveries without a known category and {rates} without a rate. Subtotals and differences include calculable amounts only.
PARTNER_REPORT.SETTINGS_SAVED: Settings saved for this account. You can edit and save them again whenever needed.
PARTNER_REPORT.SETTINGS_SAVE_ERROR: Could not save. Check the timezone and rates and try again. Previously saved settings were kept.
PARTNER_REPORT.SETTINGS_LOAD_ERROR: Could not load saved settings. Reload the page before saving to avoid overwriting them.
PARTNER_REPORT.ERROR: Unable to generate the report. Check your filters and try again.

ERRORS.invalid_period: Choose a valid period of up to 366 days.
ERRORS.invalid_parameters: Check the dates, rates and filters.
ERRORS.invalid_rate: Rates must be nonnegative numbers up to 1,000,000.
ERRORS.period_too_large: More than 100,000 messages. Shorten the period or select one inbox pair.

PARTNER_REPORT.EMPTY: No partner inbox links found in this account.
PARTNER_REPORT.COUNTS_HELP: An inbound message observed by both providers counts as two provider receipts but only one unique message. Echoes, edits and deletions are not new sends. Missing transport evidence remains unidentified.
PARTNER_REPORT.DISCLAIMER: Estimate, not an invoice. Since October 1, 2026: 1,000 free service messages per number/month only, no rollover; utility is charged even within 24 h. Inbound messages are not charged. An ad referral with source_id answered through Meta within 24 h opens the selected window, exempting all categories. Seven-day eligibility depends on your WABA; 72 h is also available. Does not authorize free-form sends outside 24 h. Earlier periods preserve previous exemptions.
PARTNER_REPORT.TIME_BASIS: The estimate uses message creation time and available delivery confirmations. Missing category, transport or delivery timestamps may prevent invoice reconciliation. Rates vary by country and category; enter rates appropriate to your scenario.
PARTNER_REPORT.NO_TIMEZONE: Enter the WABA timezone to estimate the allowance reset at midnight on the first of each month.
PARTNER_REPORT.MONTHS: Monthly service usage through the end of the period
PARTNER_REPORT.MONTH_HELP: Includes usage from the first of the month, even when your filter starts later. The allowance is grouped by business number, not contact.
